documents.proposal:
## Problem
Confirmed via tool catalog: all 6 delta tools are realm:spec/group:write; no adv_delta_list or adv_delta_show exists. The only read path (adv_change_show) truncates the deltas array past the 21k budget. So staged deltas whose ids aren't already known cannot be enumerated, read, amended, or retracted.

## Fix (read-only, no workflow change)
- adv_delta_list(changeId, capability?, offset?, limit?) — bounded paginated rows {id, operation, target_id or requirement.id, title, capability}. Default limit ~25, cap ~100. Surfaces the ids amend/retract need without blowing the output budget.
- adv_delta_show(changeId, capability, deltaId) — full content of one staged delta for exact-postimage verification. Typed not-found on unknown id.

Both read change.deltas[] disk-first (survive orphaned workflows). realm:spec, group:read, risk:low. NO signal, NO reducer, NO workflows.ts edit → no replay-determinism concern; only additive parity surfaces (registry/policy/catalog/preflight/title/banner/index allowlist) overlap the in-flight replaceRecoveryToolSprawl (mechanical merge).

## Verification
Tool unit tests: list returns ids for a multi-delta change, respects pagination + capability filter, stays under budget; show returns full delta by id, typed not-found on unknown id. schemas:check + generate:manifests:check green. No migration.

## Out of scope
Any write/mutation; changing adv_change_show truncation; archive preview.
documents.problemStatement: The staged-delta write vocabulary (adv_delta_add/modify/amend/remove/rename/retract) is complete, but there is NO read primitive. amend/retract require a deltaId that prior sessions never surface; adv_change_show truncates deltas past its ~21k output budget (a change with ~30k of deltas loses them); and archive dryRun needs all 7 gates so there is no mid-flight preview. Prior-session staged deltas become unreadable and unfixable. Add read-only adv_delta_list (bounded, paginated) + adv_delta_show (full single delta) to surface delta ids + content.
documents.agreement:
## Objectives
Provide read access to staged spec-deltas so their ids + content can be surfaced (making amend/retract usable) without exceeding output budgets.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: adv_delta_list(changeId) returns bounded rows {id, operation, capability, target (target_id or requirement.id), title} for all staged deltas across capabilities; supports capability filter + offset/limit pagination (default limit 25, cap 100); output stays within budget for delta-heavy changes.
- AC2: adv_delta_show(changeId, capability, deltaId) returns the full staged delta; typed not-found error on unknown deltaId with no mutation.
- AC3: Both are read-only (no signal/mutation), read change.deltas[] disk-first, and function on a change whose workflow is orphaned/unreachable.
- AC4: Tools registered across all parity surfaces (registry/policy/catalog/preflight/title/banner/index allowlist); schemas:check + generate:manifests:check green.

## Constraints
- C1: Read-only — no signals, no reducers, no workflows.ts edit, no migration.
- C2: Bounded/paginated output — never emit unbounded delta content.

## Avoidances
- DONT1: Do not change adv_change_show truncation behavior.
- DONT2: Do not interrupt the replaceRecoveryToolSprawl agent; merge-time coordination only.
documents.design:
## Architecture (read-only)

Two tool handlers in `tools/spec-delta.ts` reading `change.deltas[]` via the store's change read (disk-first — same path adv_change_show/validate use; survives orphaned workflows). No signal, no reducer, no workflows.ts edit → no replay-determinism concern, no migration.

### adv_delta_list(changeId, capability?, offset?, limit?)
- Load change; flatten `deltas[cap][]` across capabilities (or filter to `capability`).
- Map each to a bounded row: `{ id, operation, capability, target: delta.target_id ?? delta.requirement?.id, title: delta.requirement?.title ?? delta.new_title ?? delta.changes?.title }`.
- Paginate: default limit 25, cap 100. Return `{ rows, pagination: { total, returned, offset, hasMore } }`.
- Bounded output by construction (summary rows only) — fixes the adv_change_show truncation gap.

### adv_delta_show(changeId, capability, deltaId)
- Find delta by id under capability; return the full delta object. Typed not-found error on unknown id (no mutation).

## Wiring (parity surfaces, mirror completeDeltaTooling)
tool-registry.ts, tool-role-policy.ts (realm:spec group:read risk:low), tool-catalog-entries.ts, tool-arg-preflight.ts, tool-title.ts, banner.ts, index.ts active-change allowlist. Then schemas:generate + generate:manifests.

## Validator
Read-only, no user-value tradeoff — no independent validation needed.
documents.executiveSummary:
## Outcome

Two read-only tools complete the staged-delta vocabulary: `adv_delta_list` (bounded, paginated summary of staged deltas) and `adv_delta_show` (full single delta by id). They surface the delta ids that `adv_delta_amend`/`adv_delta_retract` require — previously unrecoverable.

## Why It Matters

`completeDeltaTooling` shipped the write side (amend/retract/remove/rename) but those need a `deltaId`, and there was no way to read staged deltas: `adv_change_show` truncates past its ~21k output budget for delta-heavy changes, and prior-session delta ids were lost. Another agent hit exactly this — 3 prior-session staged deltas were unreadable and unfixable. This closes that gap: list → get ids → show → amend/retract.

## Verification

- 52 spec-delta tests (6 new read tests: cross-capability list, capability filter, pagination + hasMore, empty change, show-by-id, unknown-id not-found) + 26 inventory tests pass
- `pnpm run check` green (typecheck/lint/format/schemas/manifests)
- Wired across all 8 parity surfaces; inventory baseline 88→90

## Structural properties

- Read-only — no signal, no reducer, no workflows.ts edit → no replay-determinism concern, minimal merge-conflict risk with the in-flight replaceRecoveryToolSprawl
- Disk-first read — works even when the change workflow is orphaned
- Bounded/paginated output by construction (fixes the truncation gap); no migration

## Risks / Follow-ups
None material. Optional future: target_path read routing (local-only in v1, sufficient for the need).
